header.title: Duration
header.description: Motion duration tokens: the `duration` object (in milliseconds), `durationCss` (as strings) and the `--gemfx-duration-*` variables.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: From `instant` (0 ms) to `slower` (1000 ms). Each bar loops with its duration so you can compare speeds.
scale.reducedMotion: With reduced motion turned on, the bars stay still.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: In CSS, use the variables (they ship in `tokens.css`, already included in `styles.css`). In TypeScript, `duration` fits the timing props of the effects, which take milliseconds.

code.props: duration and delay props take milliseconds
